To understand this effect I advice you to do this.

Get a camera that has an mechanical zoom.

  • Take your dog have a big object at the back of your dog. Use wide and go close to your dog. Take the picture.
  • Then move away and use the maximum zoom you have that the picture and notice that the object behind your dog is now bigger. The more you zoom in the bigger the objects at the back becomes.

So the answer, the upper image is taken with a wide angle, the lower image taken with a very powerful zoom.
